notes: The browser, rebuilt for one hand: everything is a single floating bar at the bottom, and the page gets the whole screen — nothing resizes or reflows it any more · The bar follows your scroll: it slips away as you read down and returns the moment you scroll up, so a site's own player bar gets the bottom edge back · Swipe the bar sideways for back and forward, tap it to type, double-tap for the top of the page, hold it for the menu — which is now a proper list, not a dropdown · Tabs are cards with a picture of each page, instead of a strip that could name two · Hold a link, a picture or a video to download it, open it in a new tab, copy or share it — with its size shown before you commit · Pinch to zoom, at last. Desktop-only sites stop being unreadable · Typing an address now offers your history, saved sites and a search, right above the keyboard · Fixed: some sites were hard to scroll — the ad blocker was doing costly busywork on every request the page made, on the thread that answers your finger. It checks in a fraction of the time now · Fixed: VR videos looked stuck and would not tilt when the phone was in your hand. The gyroscope assumed the phone was upright in landscape; it now works however you hold it, and starts looking wherever you point it · Fixed: Recentre in VR actually recentres while the gyroscope is on
